payload.description_html: Fig 13. Life reconstruction of the non-marine component of the Waterloo Farm biota. Hyneria udlezinye is shown together with the tetrapods Umzantsia amazana and Tutusius umlambo [11], the placoderms Groenlandaspis riniensis and Bothriolepis africana [19], the coelacanth Serenichthys kowiensis [27], the lungfish Isityumzi mlomomde [28], and a cyrtoctenid eurypterid. Painting by Maggie Newman, copyright R. W. Gess.
